title: Formulate an accountable engineering improvement proposal
description: Turn a supported lesson into a bounded proposal with an owner, affected subjects, intended behavior, and assessment criteria suitable for controlled change. Adoption authority and the actual transition are delegated to the existing change behaviors.
inputs: Supported lesson mechanism, evidence basis, and applicability limits.
Affected guidance, checks, or artifacts and their responsible owners.
Proposed behavior change and observable success/adverse-effect criteria.
preconditions: A supported basis for the improvement is identifiable; unresolved proposal details remain explicit.
outputs: An attributable improvement proposal and its assessment intent.
Missing-owner, subject, scope, or criterion findings that prevent readiness for adoption.
behavior: Relate the proposed change to the supported mechanism and applicable situations.
Identify current affected subjects and the responsible owner.
Make intended behavior, success criteria, and adverse-effect criteria explicit before adoption.
Supply the proposal to controlled change and retain the reference to its governing decision and baseline when reported.
Keep proposed adoption and assessed effectiveness distinct; do not manufacture permission from a recommendation.

failure_behavior.condition: The owner, affected subject, or observable assessment criterion is missing.
failure_behavior.outcome: Identify the deficiency and do not describe the proposal as ready for adoption.

failure_behavior.condition: No governing adoption decision is available.
failure_behavior.outcome: Leave the improvement proposed or unresolved without reporting an adopted change.

sources.basis: SR-037 requires accountable improvement proposals whose adoption uses IR-003 controlled-change and authority obligations.

Propose MOD-009 as the single accountable architectural responsibility for the existing behavior. This allocation preserves the Function definition and does not establish implementation or completed interface/AR coverage outside the IR-001 pilot.
